sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Keep the entire pale warm-grey/grey-green painted backdrop through all four canvas edges; this is not a framed card, note or silhouette cutout. Exact156x210 original has actual alpha249..255 and looks solid across its complete background, subject and dark clothing. Near-frontal person with a calm serious closed or very faintly parted mouth and neutral forward gaze. A large dark navy peaked cap fills the upper crop and is slightly clipped by the top canvas; it has narrow reddish outer crown piping, a central gold wreath-shaped badge, a black band, horizontal braided gold cord/end fastenings and a plain glossy black visor. Preserve that actual silhouette and small badge footprint; do not add the brim-leaf pattern used by a different source. Hair is mostly concealed by the cap, with only tiny dark temple traces and faint short eyebrow hair visible under its shadow. The upper lip and chin look smooth without a separate moustache/beard; keep that clean facial-hair state and do not turn nose/lip shadow into hair. No eyewear is visible. Dark navy lapelled uniform coat, light grey shirt, black necktie, small gold shoulder symbols/buttons at the cropped left/right shoulders; no chest medal group is visible. Tight head-and-upper-chest crop, soft forehead/nose/cheek highlights, deeper cap-brim and chin/collar shadows, original restrained mouth and brow mood. Adapt a compact yellow mascot head with a very short broad collar transition while retaining the actual shirt/tie/lapels and cap. Exact PNG, full nearest4x and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed. visible-source-differences-v1 evidence limit: the fine badge interior, faint under-brim brow hairs and tiny shoulder-symbol linework are not fully readable; no exact small symbol/hair-strand match is claimed or invented. visible-alpha-v1 retains the actual alpha numbers and requires no visible holes/backing loss; preserve the visibly solid complete painted canvas.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Retain the complete pale warm-grey painted background through every canvas corner/edge and all original dark uniform pixels; no photo frame, overlapping note or cutout exterior exists. Exact156x210 original has actual alpha249..255 and looks solid. Person turns slightly toward screen-left in a three-quarter/near-frontal bust, eyes looking a little toward that direction, with a serious narrow mouth and faint central lip separation. The dark navy peaked cap has a broad rounded crown cropped at the top, black band/strap and visor, a central gold anchor/wreath badge, and distinct gold leaf branches embroidered across the visor. Hair is largely hidden, with small dark temple traces and dark brows under the brim; upper lip and chin are visibly smooth, with no separate moustache/beard. Preserve the clean-shaven source rather than interpreting lip/nose shade as facial hair. No glasses. Dark navy lapelled uniform jacket, light grey shirt, dark tie, gold shoulder piping/buttons and two small gold naval emblems on the left/right lapels; preserve their real positions/footprints without adding a chest-medal array. Stronger lit nose and near cheek, dark cap-brim/side-face shadows, original bust crop and backdrop shading. Adapt only the body to compact yellow mascot anatomy, keep the short broad neck seated naturally in the source shirt collar/tie. Exact PNG, nearest4x and user mascot reference actually viewed, no other original substituted. visible-source-differences-v1 evidence limit: internal cap/lapel-emblem linework and tiny shoulder symbols cannot be read precisely at this source resolution; keep their visible gold groups rather than inventing readable lettering. visible-alpha-v1 retains measured numbers and requires the painted background/clothes to stay visibly solid without holes.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Preserve the full pale beige-grey/grey-green painted backdrop and original clothing through all edges, not a card, note or transparent figure silhouette. Exact156x210 original has actual alpha230..255; every corner and the whole painted field were actually viewed as solid-looking. Person has a slightly raised three-quarter head turned toward screen-right, with eyes looking to that side/upward and a restrained closed mouth largely overlain by a broad grey moustache. Keep the actual thick grey moustache, its sideways/drooping ends and grey/dark brows; the chin is smooth without a separate beard. No spectacles. Tall dark brown-black fur winter cap with raised side sections, a dark blue crown panel edged with fine gold piping, and a central round red/gold badge. Hair itself is mostly concealed by the cap, with no invented new hairstyle. Dark navy formal uniform coat with broad lapels/double-breasted overlap, pale grey-white shirt and black tie; small shoulder star/button groups remain at the crop edges. Preserve source upward angle, serious mouth/brow mood, strong cheek/nose highlights and jaw/cap shadows, bust crop and full painted backdrop. Fit the compact yellow head to a very short broad transition at the existing shirt collar without floating fur/collar or adding a neck bib. Exact PNG, full nearest4x and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed. visible-source-differences-v1 evidence limit: the round badge interior and tiny shoulder insignia cannot be read exactly; no precise symbol/word is invented. Moustache presence/extent is clearly visible and is not an ambiguity. visible-alpha-v1 keeps actual alpha230..255 as measured rather than falsely calling the original all255; preserve the complete visibly solid painted canvas and avoid new holes.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Retain the whole dark charcoal upper background fading to muted grey below, with all original teal clothing and painted field through all four edges; there is no frame, overlapping note or exterior figure cutout. Exact156x210 original has actual alpha254..255 and looks solid. A person with short glossy black hair arranged in voluminous sculpted waves: a raised rolled front/top crest and rounded swept side/back curls; preserve this full asymmetric hairstyle silhouette rather than making the head bald, braided or adding a hat. Fine dark brows, no eyewear, no moustache/beard, softly closed or barely separated lips with a reserved faint smile, head and gaze slightly toward screen-left. Teal/blue-green satin-like blouse with a closed high standing collar and curved/diagonal front overlap seam, strong smooth cloth highlights and folds; no necklace, lapel suit, scarf or visible medal group. Keep the real closed collar state and cloth seam layout while fitting the compact yellow mascot head immediately into a short broad collar transition. Head-and-upper-torso crop, forehead/nose/cheek highlights, softer jaw/under-chin shadows and the original subdued dark-to-grey painted lighting. Exact PNG, full nearest4x and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed; no auxiliary substitution. visible-source-differences-v1 evidence limit: individual fine hair fibres and tiny seam/fastening linework are not microscopically readable, so no invented buttons, jewellery or exact fibre match is claimed. The voluminous short-wave silhouette, visible brows and standing collar are clear requirements. visible-alpha-v1 retains actual alpha254..255 and requires visibly solid cloth/background without added transparency.
